Results.ReviewText: My wife said she wanted to get me a grill for Fathers day and thats when I researched for grills. I looked into many websites for my grill and the one that always ranked  highest was the E-310. I had it assembled and delivered to me within a week from Lowes. Weber has produced a terrific grill in the E-310. It heats up to 600+ degrees in 10 minutes or less, it maintains the heat with the lid close and even open, the cast iron grates retain the heat and put beautiful grill marks on everything. The flavor of my protein comes out great. I have done chicken,pork,hot dogs,brats,steak and everything comes out very tasty. I could not be happier with my choice and the quality that Weber creates is exceptional.
Results.Title: Great Grill with plenty of heat

Results.ReviewText: We absolutely love this grill!  Perfect size for our small back porch, but still plenty of cooking area. We can’t stop grilling!  Our last grill was not a Weber, and we were very disappointed in it.  It barely lasted 3 years, and never got hot enough to sear anything.  This grill heats provides plenty of strong, even heat, but is also able to maintain lower temps, and we have raved about everything we have cooked on it, from steaks to veggies.  We just bought the rotisserie attachment and can’t wait to try that! This grill was a great purchase, and we will be sticking with Weber from now on.

Results.ReviewText: I had high expectations for this grill because of the Weber brand and because it has received very high reviews from sources I trust most (i.e. Wirecutter). It also wasn't cheap. My expectations have been far exceeded. This thing is solidly built and performs incredibly. I used the optional app-based setup instructions, which were really helpful. It ignites quickly, easily, and consistently, heats fast and evenly, and allows a great level of control over temperature. I really like the two-sided grill grates (one side thin for more delicate foods, one side wider) -- the wider side provides an excellent sear with minimal sticking.
Results.Title: Easily the best grill I've used

ClientResponses.Response: Hi Daniel! Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are very sorry to hear that your experience did not match your expectations. It looks like you have received your warranty items! If you experience the same issue, we recommend using a new tank before replacing your hose, and depending on usage, please clean the cross over tube using a small stainless steel brush. The tube carries the gas from one burner to another and can get clogged over normal grill use. If you have any questions or concerns, please let us know! Thanks again, and we hope you get many great meals off of it this summer!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
